Data Engineer — Lion City Bank (fictional)
Location: Singapore (Marina Bay) — Hybrid
Industry: Banking & Financial Services

About us
Lion City Bank is a leading regional bank serving retail and corporate clients across Southeast Asia.

The role
You will join our Data Platform team to design and operate batch and streaming pipelines feeding our risk and regulatory reporting.

Responsibilities
- Design, build and maintain data pipelines with Apache Airflow and PySpark
- Model data in our cloud data warehouse (Snowflake) using SQL and dbt
- Implement data-quality monitoring and lineage
- Work with risk analysts to deliver regulatory reports (MAS)

Requirements
- Degree in Computer Science, Engineering or related field
- 0–2 years of experience in data engineering (fresh graduates with strong internships welcome)
- Strong Python and SQL
- Experience with Spark and an orchestration tool (Airflow preferred)

Nice to have
- dbt, Snowflake
- Kafka or other streaming technologies
- Exposure to financial services

Compensation
SGD 84,000 – 108,000 per annum, plus annual bonus.

Apply by sending your CV to talent@lioncitybank.example
